x: Then of what possible benefit could Arthur Rowe's rugby league football be to his shot-putting?

British athletics has never recovered from the early retirements of Arthur Rowe and Mike Ellis. The former's 59'2" shot win and the latter's 210'7" hammer heave make their counterparts of today look modest performers indeed.
This trend will continue for as long as the Arthur Rowes and the Berwyn Jones's of this world are discriminated against by rules that only sort out the "private" offender.
